risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and quantitatively detailed, reporting earnings, credit metrics, revenue changes, expenses, merger terms, and macroeconomic assumptions. Risk tone is cautiously positive, but pandemic uncertainty, inflation, supply-chain disruption, tightening financial conditions, geopolitical tensions, and merger execution risks remain material. Forward-looking caveats and reliance on external forecasts introduce moderate uncertainty.
